levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more rewritten statements still contain judging words or opinions dressed as description.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All three rewritten statements are neutral and describe only physical sensations.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner precisely identifies the exact word or phrase that made the original version a judgment.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The reflection does not explain any difference between how the judging and noticing versions felt to read.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The reflection names a specific difference between reading the judging version and the noticing version.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner gives a reasoned case for why noticing without judging is useful even when a signal is uncomfortable.

lookFors: No rewritten 'noticing' statement contains a judging word like should, lazy, bad, or good.
The original judging thought sounds like something the learner would plausibly actually think, not an invented worst-case example.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
